description:
List the discussion (comments and replies) of a CoreModels project — the same threads users see in the app's grid collaboration panel. Viewer access is required.

Comments are anchored by tag sets: a comment left on a grid cell carries that cell's tag ids (node/element/relation ids, sometimes a section label) plus the project id. Omit anchorIds to list the whole project's discussion; pass anchorIds to return only comments anchored to exactly that tag set (the project id is implied — never include it).

Returns { comments, total, returned, truncated }. comments are top-level threads, newest first, each with its replies nested oldest first; every entry has { id, createdBy, createdByName, message, anchorIds, mentionUserIds, parentId, isResolved, createdDate }. Reply to a thread or leave a new one with add_comment (admin endpoint).

anchorIds.description: Optional cell anchor: return only comments whose anchor tag set equals exactly this set. Do not include the project id.

graphProjectId.description: Id of the project whose discussion to read. Viewer access is required.

includeReplies.description: Nest each thread's replies in the response.

maxResults.description: Cap on returned top-level threads (newest first); truncated=true when more matched.

textContains.description: Optional text filter, matched in comments and replies.

name: list_comments
title: List Comments
